# Wishly International

Wishly International is the English-first discovery and editorial website for personal websites, digital gifts, birthday pages, proposals, love letters, anniversaries and online invitations.

- International site: https://wishly.rafahim.com/
- Main Wishly product website: https://wishly.bd/
- The main product website handles sign-up, login, the visual editor, dashboard, checkout, publishing and live page management.

## Main discovery pages
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/templates/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/features/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/how-to-make-website/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/guides/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/about/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/faq/
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/sitemap.xml

The website has occasion collections, individual template descriptions and practical editorial guides. Template capabilities vary by design; use each template's own preview and details as the source of truth.


## International audience and language
- The editorial website is currently English-first and is intended for worldwide discovery by English-language searchers.
- Template pages identify whether an individual design is English or Bengali. Visitors should check the language label and preview before using a design.
- No country-specific pricing, payment method or feature availability is promised here. Account and product availability are determined by the main Wishly website.
- Regional English wording such as “personalized/personalised”, “birthday website maker/creator”, “birthday webpage” and “digital love letter” is used naturally where relevant.
- Country and language research notes are maintained in `docs/international-keyword-research-and-market-map.md` in the source repository; they are editorial planning notes, not a public country landing page.
